evidence.artifact: Requires mapping/feedback changes or a range/scale/value/endpoint/precision specification and synchronized applied value.

evidence.verification: Checks endpoints, intermediate values, keyboard/assistive increments, field synchronization and relevant undo; fails unexplained inversion or unreachable required precision.
evidence.applicability: Preserves iOS output-volume view, unsupported TV slider, horizontal visionOS movement and explicitly onscreen buttons beside the watch slider after independent wording repair.

evidence.distinctiveness: Actual value mapping and precision, fixed versus repeating domains and corrected onscreen-watch-button meaning create specific slider decisions.
